title: The Tryouts of Route 9
author: August Eriksen
blurb: Mara Eastwick, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must save the tradition that made the town before prom.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
